declarations.description:
Buttons represent actions that are available to the user.

Velcro extensions inherited from the core button and kept working: `toggle` / `pressed` (an aria-pressed toggle that
emits `change`), `expanded` and `current` (aria-expanded / aria-current), `autofocus`, `referrerpolicy` on links, and
`shows` / `hides` / `toggles`. The core `icon-only` and `allow-wrap` attributes are accepted but have no effect.
declarations.name: VelcroButton

members.description: Removes focus from the button.

members.name: button

members.name: caret
members.description: Draws the button with a caret. Used to indicate that the button triggers a dropdown menu or similar behavior.

members.name: checkValidity
members.description: Checks for validity but does not show a validation message. Returns `true` when valid and `false` when invalid.

members.name: circle
members.description:
Draws a circular icon button. When this attribute is present, the button expects a single icon element in the
default slot.

members.name: click
members.description:
Simulates a click on the button. As in Shoelace, once rendered it always activates the inner native button or link
exactly once: a disabled native button ignores it, a disabled link's click reaches host listeners without
navigating, and a host `preventDefault()` cancels a link's default action.

members.name: current
members.description: Sets "aria-current" on the internal button or link.

members.name: dir
members.description: The dir global attribute is an enumerated attribute that indicates the directionality of the element's text.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the button.

members.name: download
members.description: Tells the browser to download the linked file as this filename. Only used when `href` is present.

members.name: expanded
members.description: Sets "aria-expanded" on the internal button or link.

members.name: focus
members.description: Sets focus on the button.

members.name: form
members.description:
The "form owner" to associate the button with. If omitted, the closest containing form will be used instead. The
value of this attribute must be an id of a form in the same document or shadow root as the button.

members.name: formAction
members.description: Used to override the form owner's `action` attribute.

members.name: formEnctype
members.description: Used to override the form owner's `enctype` attribute.

members.name: formMethod
members.description: Used to override the form owner's `method` attribute.

members.name: formNoValidate

members.name: formTarget
members.description: Used to override the form owner's `target` attribute.

members.name: getForm
members.description: Gets the associated form, if one exists.

members.name: hides
members.description: referencing a dismissible element's ID, this button will hide it when clicked. Does nothing while disabled.

members.name: href
members.description: When set, the underlying button will be rendered as an `<a>` with this `href` instead of a `<button>`.

members.name: iconOnly
members.description:
Allows component to render using only the icon as visual element.
Optional, default is false, associated attribute is 'icon-only'

members.name: loading
members.description: Draws the button in a loading state.

members.name: name
members.description:
The name of the button, submitted as a name/value pair with form data, but only when this button is the submitter.
This attribute is ignored when `href` is present.

members.name: outline
members.description: Draws an outlined button.

members.name: pill
members.description: Draws a pill-style button with rounded edges.

members.name: pressed
members.description: Sets "aria-pressed" on the internal button or link.

members.name: referrerPolicy
members.description:
Defining which referrer is sent when fetching the resource.
Only applies to links.

members.name: rel
members.description:
When using `href`, this attribute will map to the underlying link's `rel` attribute. Unlike regular links, the
default is `noreferrer noopener` to prevent security exploits. However, if you're using `target` to point to a
specific tab/window, this will prevent that from working correctly. You can remove or change the default value by
setting the attribute to an empty string or a value of your choice, respectively.

members.name: reportValidity
members.description: Checks for validity and shows the browser's validation message if the control is invalid.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets a custom validation message. Pass an empty string to restore validity.

members.name: shows
members.description: referencing a dismissible element's ID, this button will show it when clicked. Does nothing while disabled.

members.name: size
members.description: The button's size.

members.name: target
members.description: Tells the browser where to open the link. Only used when `href` is present.

members.name: title
members.description: Passed through to the inner control; an empty title also hides the browser's validation tooltip on hover.

members.name: toggle
members.description:
Allows a toggling behavior on the component that emits change event if not disabled.
Only when is a button.

members.name: toggles
members.description: referencing a dismissible element's ID, this button will show/hide it when clicked. Does nothing while disabled.

members.name: type
members.description:
The type of button. Note that the default value is `button` instead of `submit`, which is opposite of how native
`<button>` elements behave. When the type is `submit`, the button will submit the surrounding form.

members.name: validationMessage
members.description: Gets the validation message.

members.name: validity
members.description: Gets the validity state object.

members.name: value
members.description:
The value of the button, submitted as a pair with the button's name as part of the form data, but only when this
button is the submitter. This attribute is ignored when `href` is present.

members.name: variant
members.description: The button's theme variant.

a date to this format in JavaScript, use `date.toISOString()`.

When `auto`, values such as "yesterday" and "tomorrow" will be shown when possible. When `always`, values such as
"1 day ago" and "in 1 day" will be shown.

declarations.description:
Switches allow the user to toggle an option on or off.

Velcro extensions inherited from the core switch and kept working: `readonly` (the switch keeps its state on click and
arrow keys), `label` (label text shown when the default slot is empty), `hide-label` (visually hides the label and
help text, which stay accessible) and `error-message` (sets a custom validity message, like `setCustomValidity()`; it
is not rendered). The core `invalid`, `label-position` and `autofocus` properties are accepted but have no effect
(use `data-invalid`, as in Shoelace). As with every Velcro form control the host carries core's `focusable`
attribute.
declarations.name: VelcroSwitch

declarations.description:
Tab panels are used inside tab groups to display tabbed content. API modelled on Shoelace's `sl-tab-panel`.

Velcro extensions inherited from the core tab panel and kept working: the core `ready` event only. The rest of core's
tab panel belongs to core's own tabs and conflicts with Shoelace's model (default slot, `active`, `display`), so it is
switched off: core's `slot="tabpanel"`, `hidden` and `transitionend` handling do not run, its internal `visible` and
`tab` properties have no effect (`visible` has no attribute either), the `tab-show`, `tab-hide`, `tab-after-show` and
`tab-after-hide` events are never emitted, and core's `--tab-panel-*` custom properties and `tab-panel-base` part do
not exist.
declarations.name: VelcroTabPanel
